title: Master of Dungeon: A Solo D&D-Inspired Text RPG
author: Tigeline
selftext:
Hey hey, 

A short description of what we’re working on: My brother and I are working on a game that’s kind of a mix between D&D and a text-based RPG. The demo is already available and we’ve done some initial testing, so you can try out the core gameplay, loot system, shop, and hero progression. 

If you wanna see how the project’s coming along, come hang out with us on Discord: [https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN](https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN) 

Or if you just want to jump straight into the game, you can play it here: [https://testflight.apple.com/join/mg6UrBH9](https://testflight.apple.com/join/mg6UrBH9) 

We put in some serious work over the weekend and made something amazing - today we wanted to show you what the introduction and immersive mode look like (depending on which option you choose!). 

We played around with it a bit and honestly, it really extends and spices up the gameplay (not that I’m biased or anything ;D), but killing the innkeeper and then the tavern massacre kinda speak for themselves. 

Let us know what you think - we’re super hyped about it and can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body: Looks great. You just write what you are doing? Are the model you are talking too following specified worlds and/or adventures, or is it completely making everything up on the fly? Is the model for this local? (Unfortunately I don't have Apple device to test it myself.)

replies.author: izhy
replies.body:
Hi,

I’m the second creator of this app ;)

Basically, we combine standard game design with AI - the AI has some information about the main plot of the adventure from the scenarios we wrote, but we leave space for creativity and let the plot evolve in different directions, so every adventure is unique :)

Model is hosted right now but we experiment right now with also using local models in some cases :) 

  
Btw. we also have android version in test so feel free to join and try it out (its right now in closed test )

replies.author: izhy
replies.body:
Hi,

I’m the second creator and one man army developer of this app ;) Thank for kind words - it really motivate to go further with progress when you read comments like this 

We using Flutter mainly because we plan release web version soon after soft lunch of mobile. (and also I have some experience in Flutter ;) )  


This UI you see is our forth or fifth iteration of the UI (we document our progress here [https://www.reddit.com/r/MasterOfDungeonAI/](https://www.reddit.com/r/MasterOfDungeonAI/) ) - and I finally can say I am really happy with results we achieved, but we spend really long time to iterate and tweak it here and there so don’t worry if something sucks sometimes - reaching cool results always takes a bit of time, but that’s exactly what makes it so satisfying 😉  
  
Also if you want some feedback feel free to write here or on discord - I will try give you some feedback.  :)
